text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastEvent(x) ::: x is the last occurrence of an event.
InLocation(x, y) ::: event x was in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Tokyo ::: the city Tokyo.
UnitedStates ::: the United States.
Premises:
SportingEvent(theSummerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastEvent(theSummerOlympics) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
InLocation(theSummerOlympics, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, theSummerOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, theSummerOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
